description: This C# source file defines a UserController class for handling user-related API endpoints in an ASP.NET Core web application. It includes actions for retrieving the current user details and updating user information, utilizing dependency injection for mediator and current user accessor services.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller responsible for user-related API endpoints, specifically retrieving and updating user information.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current user's details, using the mediator pattern to send a query with the current username.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update user information based on the provided command object from the request body.
